Lenusa – Graphic Design Intern

Things I do and make while working as an intern in PT. Lenusa Konsultan Indonesia.

What I do here?

While I'm here, I've learned a lot. Back to basics: not just mindlessly making design like I did before, I learned the basics of graphic design, such as hierarchy, balance, typography, etc.

In my time here, I managed visual brand identity at PT Lenusa Konsultan Indonesia by strictly enforcing brand guidelines across all corporate touchpoints. Collaborated cross-functionally to design professional presentation decks, comprehensive training booklets, promotional posters, and engaging social media infographics, ensuring meticulous visual consistency and high-quality communication across both print and digital surfaces.

My journey

Six things I learned and shipped as a graphic design intern at PT Lenusa Konsultan Indonesia.

  1. 01

    Back to basics

    Before making anything, I went back to the fundamentals: hierarchy, balance and typography. Every piece after this started from those rules instead of guesswork.

    • Hierarchy
    • Balance
    • Typography
  2. 02

    Learning the brand

    I worked on the visual identity of Litologi by Lenusa through its Graphic Standard Manual, covering logo, colour, typography, pattern and mockups so every touchpoint stays consistent.

    • Brand guidelines
    • Logo system
    • Consistency
  3. 03

    Decks and event banners

    I designed presentation decks and banner options for in-house training and certification events, keeping the look consistent from slide to banner.

    • Presentation
    • Banners
    • Events
  4. 04

    Booklets and reports

    I laid out training booklets and reports, such as external training reports and brochures, with covers and layouts that can be reused for the next one.

    • Training booklets
    • Reports
    • Print
  5. 05

    Posters and merchandise

    I made promotional posters and merchandise for Lenusa International Training 2027, with a pattern set carried across posters and tote bag colourways.

    • Posters
    • Merchandise
    • Pattern
  6. 06

    From brand to web

    I designed pages for the Lenusa.id website, the 2027 training schedule and software product pages, turning the brand into a responsive website experience.

    • Website
    • Schedule
    • Product pages
